name: Towers and Bunkers
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Pays 90s instead of 0. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Towers and bunkers are important positions, and we must capture and hold them all!  So to that end, I want you to attack a bunker that is controlled by the enemy.

To do that, enter one with an Alliance banner.  You will see another banner inside.  Pull out that banner, and a white Horde banner will appear in its place.  Well done!

At that point your task for me will be complete, but if you hold the place long enough, and if the Alliance doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!
narrative.objectives: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
narrative.offerRewardText: I heard of your mission's success! That pleases me...Our troops can now charge forward with impunity, and show the Alliance that Alterac Valley is no place for them!
narrative.requestItemsText: You haven't yet assaulted a bunker, adventurer! Are you waiting for others to claim your glory?
